games.name: [CHURCH] Anomaly Watch
games.desc:
Anomaly Watch is a horror game inspired by the Mandela Catalogue and the I'm On Observation Duty games. In Anomaly Watch you are sent to explore a rural house where unexplainable events happen, objects go missing, become distorted, and strange humanoids appear. Your job is to recognize and report unexplainable events and most importantly, report unrecognizable creatures and intruders. All in all survive until 6 am. Good Luck!

House Keybinds:
PC: Equip Tablet - R
Mobile: Equip Tablet - Button on side of the screen.

Office Keybinds:
Flashlight: F or Gamepad B
Sprint: Left Shift or Gamepad R1
Exiting the reporter: Jump

Horror outside human comprehension.
Thank you for playing Anomaly Watch

Developer: punitto
Icon art: Jslay0_0

games.name: The Robloxia: Until Dawn
games.desc:
THIS GAME CONTAINS FLASHING LIGHTS

Welcome to The Robloxia: Until Dawn, a game that tries to turn popular classic roblox myths and etc. all together into a survival game, team up with with 5 more survivors against different killers and try to escape their grip, or play as them and eliminate everyone on sight before the portal spawns.

Took concepts, soundtracks and inspiration from:
- Sonic.EXE: The Disaster (RIP)
- Sonic.EXE: Spectral Fades
- Left4Dead2
- Mob of the dead

Some soundtracks are used without permission as said composers were quite hard to contact, if you own a soundtrack that is used in the game and can prove that it is made by you then please join our community server and contact me there, it will be replaced if needed. All credits are in the game.

I do not own any licenses of any un-official/original soundtracks used in the game, nor any rights to anything else. This is just a passion project for fun

Originally made on February 10th 2023
